mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIP_SCHEDULE ( GROUP_ID, DAY_NUMBER, PLAN_TIME, PLACE, MEMO, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{dayNumber}, #{planTime}, #{place}, #{memo}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, GROUP_ID, DAY_NUMBER, PLAN_TIME, PLACE, MEMO, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM TRIP_SCHEDULE WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIP_SCHEDULE SET DAY_NUMBER = #{dayNumber}, PLAN_TIME = #{planTime}, PLACE = #{place}, MEMO = #{memo}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
